breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use constant internal torque of 150000 N·mm for both stress and twist calculations,' directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this instruction, requiring piecewise constant internal torques: 300,000 N·mm in Segment 2 (750→1500 mm) and 150,000 N·mm in Segment 1 (0→750 mm). The agent failed to treat the internal torque as piecewise constant across the two segments.
